## Notes

Limbic Entertainment, Kalypso Media; Windows, macOS, Linux 2019-03-29; PS4 and Xbox One 2019-09-27; Switch 2020-11-06; PS5 and Xbox Series 2022; four eras (Colonial, World Wars, Cold War, Modern); archipelago with bridges from the World Wars era; fully simulated citizens whose treatment affects productivity and revolt; raids; multiplayer.
